meta.title: PO Short Close: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Open and perform PO Short Close before the full quantity or value is consumed
Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify the action is refused or absent
Repeat the action as a Buyer and verify it is available
Compare the two role outcomes while accounting for tenant-specific RBAC configuration
